rule: A combat cycle has two phases: phase 0 lasts 3000 ms, then phase 1 runs until 6000 ms from cycle start, then the cycle repeats. At each phase boundary the end hook resolves damage for creatures that had a target, then the begin hook sets new targets and plays the attacker swing and the target dodge. Damage = sum of weapon dice plus ability modifier (both hands summed; unarmed = 1 + strength modifier), no hit roll, no range check at resolve. HP at or below a floor is clamped to the floor (1 when Min1HP is set) and combat is cancelled. Death: die animation once, then dead pose held, then user event 1007. Shake and impact fields exist only as schema names (cutscene shake ids, GDA column names); no reader in src.
keep: Telegraph before resolve: swing and dodge visible before damage lands.
Damage resolves on a beat the server can enforce.
Minimum-HP floor as a per-encounter flag (first-fight, onboarding).
Die once, then hold the dead pose.
change: Beat length: fast duels need a fraction of a second, not three seconds; make it a data field.
Drive the beat from the server tick with a fixed step, not the engine clock.
Re-check range at resolve; the donor checks only at begin.
Add a real hit roll before damage; the dodge plays today with no roll.
Many-on-one: phase-offset the three attackers on one shared beat (idea to test; not in donor).
look_test: Presentation-only flag (feel.beat), no release rows. Publish two clips of the same three-on-one fight at 375 wide: A = each attacker on free timing; B = three attackers on one shared beat with a stagger. Dom judges which lets him read and dodge each incoming hit on a phone.
